cards.name: Mystical Elf
cards.description: A delicate elf that lacks in offence but has terrific defense backed by mystical power.

cards.name: Time Wizard
cards.description: A sorcerer capable of bending time to his will. Though not powerful at first glance, appearances can be deceiving.

cards.name: Right Leg of the Forbidden One
cards.description: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Who ever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type can be included in a deck.

cards.name: Left Leg of the Forbidden One
cards.description: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Who ever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type can be included in a deck.

cards.name: Right Arm of the Forbidden One
cards.description: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Who ever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type can be included in a deck.

cards.name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One
cards.description: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Who ever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type can be included in a deck.

cards.name: Exodia the Forbidden
cards.description: Once combined with arms and legs, this monster is freed from its magical chains. Only one card of this type can be included in a deck.

cards.name: Saggi the Dark Clown
cards.description: This clown appears out of nowhere and executes some very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.

cards.name: Dark Magician
cards.description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attacks and defense.

cards.name: Illusionist Faceless Mage
cards.description: Manipulates enemies attacks with the power of illusion. A very rare card.

cards.name: Rogue Doll
cards.description: A unique doll gifted with mystical power. Particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

cards.name: Curtain of the Dark Ones
cards.description: A curtain woven by the hands of a sorcerer. It is said to enhance the power of magic-users.

cards.name: Spirit of the Winds
cards.description: A spirit of the wind that freely sails the skies. Known to generate storms when it's in a bad mood.

cards.name: White Magical Hat
cards.description: A gentleman thief that eludes the law despite the fact that he sticks out like a sore thumb with his silk hat and white cape.

cards.name: Kamion Wizard
cards.description: A magic-user that controls chaos and wields a mighty sickle.

cards.name: LaMoon
cards.description: A sorcerer who lives on the moon and attacks opponents with the power of lunar light.

cards.name: Nemuriko
cards.description: A child-like creature that controls a sleep spirit to beckon enemies into an eternal slumber.

cards.name: Flame Manipulator
cards.description: Attacks enemies with fire-related spells, such as the "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".

cards.name: Necrolancer the Timelord
cards.description: The first in a line of golems that appear almost from with in a dimensional ring.

cards.name: Djinn the Watcher of the Wind
cards.description: Controls the air currents to create violent winds and tornadoes to blow away its enemies.

cards.name: The Bewitching Phantom Thief
cards.description: A flashy, black-caped thief who wields a magic cane.

cards.name: Hurricail
cards.description: A twister that runs rampant in the wastelands, cutting its enemies with blades of wind.

cards.name: Phantom Dewan
cards.description: A wizard that freezes an enemy's movement with a single curse.

cards.name: Lucky Trinket
cards.description: A thin and reedy creature protected by sacred power.

cards.name: Genin
cards.description: Uses amazing sleight-of-hand to fool an destroy enemies.

cards.name: Akakieisu
cards.description: A wizard whose incantations numb the senses of opposing monsters.

cards.name: Aqua Madoor
cards.description: A wizard of the waters that conjures up a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

cards.name: Dryad
cards.description: A spirit of the forest protected by the surrounding plant life.

cards.name: Masked Sorcerer
cards.description: A mysterious wizard whose face remains forever hidden behind a strange mask.

cards.name: Angelwitch
cards.description: A creature that chose the path of sorcery to become a witch.

cards.name: Ancient Sorcerer
cards.description: A master fighter that uses various staffs to render enemies unconscious.

cards.name: Sectarian of Secrets
cards.description: A sorcerer that worships the dark forces and can summon a massive hand to drag away opponents into the netherworld.

cards.name: Tao the Chanter
cards.description: A magic user that corrodes the yin and yang to create a twisted power to attack enemies.

cards.name: Fairy's Gift
cards.description: Flies around spreading happiness to all.

cards.name: Kazejin
cards.description: A golem that controls the winds like the labyrinth brothers.

cards.name: Mystic Lamp
cards.description: A lamp used by wizards to mix potions.

cards.name: Magician of Faith
cards.description: Despite its weak strength, this creature is capable of casting spells to eliminate darkness.

cards.name: Ancient Elf
cards.description: This elf is rumored to have lived for thousands of years. He leads an army of spirits against his enemies.

cards.name: Boo Koo
cards.description: A book wizard with page after page of potent spells.

cards.name: Maha Vailo
cards.description: A wizard dressed in blue who is usually found meditating.

cards.name: Musician King
cards.description: A fantastic guitar player that attacks enemies with ultrasonic emissions.

cards.name: Spirit of the Mountain
cards.description: Music from this creature's flute can drain an enemy's willpower.

cards.name: Eldeen
cards.description: Uses a wand to cast various spells against an enemy.

cards.name: Gemini Elf
cards.description: Elf twins that attack an enemy from opposite sides.

cards.name: Dark Elf
cards.description: A wicked elf that just loves to engage in battle.

cards.name: Witch of the Black Forest
cards.description: This forest-dwelling witch can see all with the eye on her forehead.

cards.name: Leo Wizard
cards.description: A wizard with a black cape that is actually a talking lion disguised as a man.

cards.name: Lady of Faith
cards.description: Soothes the souls of others by chanting a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Rock Spirit
cards.description: A clay idol representing a rock spirit. The creature has significant attack and defense factors.

cards.name: Ill Witch
cards.description: Controls air currents and can generate a sudden gust of wind to blow away an opponent.

cards.name: Witch's Apprentice
cards.description: An inexperienced witch who just started learning the mystic dark arts.

cards.name: Maiden of the Moonlight
cards.description: A lunar sorcerer that uses mystical spells to induce hallucinations.

cards.name: Skull Knight
cards.description: A monk who has conducted several rituals in the netherworld, and who is capable of using both weapons and magic.

cards.name: Cosmo Queen
cards.description: A queen who rules over all the stars in the universe.

cards.name: Mask of Shine & Dark
cards.description: A creature that twists the fabric of light and darkness to generate images to confuse opponents.

cards.name: Magician of Black Chaos
cards.description: The ultimate magic-user, who wields the power of chaos born from the fusion of Dark and Light.
